documents.title: Clarification Letter On Price Movement Of Our Securities
Clarification sought from Premier Polyfilm Ltd
Clarification On Significant Increase In Trading Volume Of Our Securities

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported a robust financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging to INR 3,188 lakhs and gross sales and other income reaching INR 34,126 lakhs. Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes driven by enhanced capacity utilization from new plant and machinery. The company secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park, commenced logistics and trading activities, and placed an order for manufacturing machines with commercial production expected in the forthcoming quarter. Additionally, the board recommended a dividend of 15% (INR 0.15 per equity share) for the financial year. Premier Polyfilm Limited published its notice for the thirty-third annual general meeting in the annual report, outlining various ordinary and special business resolutions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured and took possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company placed an order for manufacturing PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machines with advance payment made.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: Management strategically discontinued product lines with sub-optimal margins to focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.
margins_costs.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: The company reduced its finance cost by arranging cheaper loans from Yes Bank Limited.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability increased because the company arranged raw materials at cheaper rates while keeping finished goods prices unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, sheetings, and films during the review period compared to 26,755 M.T. previously.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Higher capacity utilization was achieved through the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to INR 0.15 per equity share of INR 1/- each for the financial year 2025-2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.15 per equity share of Rs.1/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2026 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The board transferred an amount of INR 400/- Lakh to General Reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

risks_headwinds.claim: The National Stock Exchange of India Limited imposed a fine of INR 50,000/- for delay in uploading the Integrated Filing containing Related Party Transaction disclosures.
risks_headwinds.quote: Accordingly, NSE imposed a fine of ₹50,000/- vide its order dated 16th February, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the past was attributed to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power such as Solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
